record_kind: Bounded component decision and outcome recorded after direct execution; not a reconstructed earlier log.
user_objective: Enable resident construction and evaluation of new executable SDF expression structure. This record covers only compilable numerical method components.
preceding_evidence: Parent reported validate_geometry exceeded unchanged XIR256 instruction capacity; source inspection showed a monolithic dynamic interpreter also needed bounded stages. The separate runtime_v3 ledger covers state capacity only.
decision: Split geometry admission into box and separation predicates plus guarded conjunction; split runtime opcode/reference interpretation into nodes0..2,3..4,5..6 plus dynamic root. Preserve numerical limits and generated grammar. Reject malformed integer program words before host decoding can truncate them.
classification: Computational implementation choice. Domain SDF mathematics is unchanged; coverage and construction are declared policies, not domain laws.
decision_after_evidence: Retain staged bindings and strict decoding; parent integrates them into the full resident source graph. No claim of an already integrated construction loop, Vulkan parity, autonomous learning or task benefit from this component experiment.
scope_limits: All candidate code and geometry must be checked before live interpretation. Interpreter stages deliberately preserve pure indexed selection, whose out-of-range fallback is zero; they are not standalone admission guards.
The generated native grammar is canonical left-associated postorder only; the independent source library supports additional valid trees.
Native geometry uses extents greater than1e-5 and strict axis separation greater than1e-4, conservatively narrower than the independent library default Euclidean separation greater thanzero.
These FP32 geometry predicates are not an exact-rational certificate near thresholds. The separate packed-constant oracle remains authoritative for mathematical admission.

Caller composition must use propose_edit.valid, validate candidate structure/geometry and reject or mask invalid candidates before eager evaluation. construct_code alone can exceed seven nodes or revision16777215 if incorrectly given valid=1 at its limits.

Split bindings pass FP32 node values between explicit calls. These probes use the existing CPU harness and do not establish Vulkan parity, persistent execution, acceptance-loop closure or task improvement.
